mapper.sql: id, order_no, student_uid, contact_name, contact_phone, campus_id, area_id, building_id, room_id, location_detail, fault_type_id, problem_description, image_urls, status, current_assignee_id, dispatch_time, accept_deadline, accept_time, expected_complete_time, complete_deadline, repair_submit_time, confirm_time, complete_time, rework_count, exception_flag, duplicate_flag, duplicate_order_id, report_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ro.id orderId,ro.order_no orderNo,ft.type_name faultTypeName, CONCAT_WS(' / ',campus.area_name,area.area_name,building.area_name,room.area_name,ro.location_detail) locationText, ro.report_time reportTime,ro.status FROM repair_order ro JOIN repair_fault_type ft ON ft.id=ro.fault_type_id JOIN repair_area campus ON campus.id=ro.campus_id JOIN repair_area area ON area.id=ro.area_id JOIN repair_area building ON building.id=ro.building_id JOIN repair_area room ON room.id=ro.room_id WHERE ro.deleted=0 AND ro.campus_id=#{campusId} AND ro.area_id=#{areaId} AND ro.building_id=#{buildingId} AND ro.room_id=#{roomId} AND ro.fault_type_id=#{faultTypeId} AND ro.report_time >=#{sinceTime} AND ro.status IN #{status} ORDER BY ro.report_time DESC,ro.id DESC
SELECT id FROM repair_order WHERE deleted=0 AND status=0 AND current_assignee_id IS NULL AND update_time<=#{before} ORDER BY update_time,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_order SET status=2,accept_time=#{acceptTime},expected_complete_time=#{expectedCompleteTime},complete_deadline=#{completeDeadline} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status=1 AND current_assignee_id=#{workerId}
UPDATE repair_order SET status=5 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status=2 AND current_assignee_id=#{workerId}
UPDATE repair_order SET status=2 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status=5 AND current_assignee_id=#{workerId}
UPDATE repair_order SET status=3,repair_submit_time=#{repairSubmitTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status IN (2,4) AND current_assignee_id=#{workerId}
UPDATE repair_order SET status=6,confirm_time=#{now},complete_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND student_uid=#{studentUid} AND status=3 AND deleted=0

UPDATE repair_order SET status=4,rework_count=rework_count+1,expected_complete_time=NULL,complete_deadline=NULL,exception_flag=CASE WHEN rework_count>=3 THEN 1 ELSE exception_flag END WHERE id=#{id} AND student_uid=#{studentUid} AND status=3 AND deleted=0
